source_authentication.warning: Cache filenames alone do not establish that a native run used these kernels. A separate metadata-only query regenerated the exact listed C bytes with Operator.apply forbidden and no Model constructor, BP arrays, native numeric data, or saved-u allocation. symbols.m: 1/(vp*vp), on the full logical grid including constant-edge padding
symbols.mu: E applied to a direction normalized on the physical m grid
symbols.q: source sample at the current integer time, fixed independently of m
symbols.p: next primal field BEFORE source injection
symbols.E: constant-edge extension from physical nodes to all logical padding, corners included

spatial_stencil.constraint: Use these emitted decimal literals, not exact rational coefficients or rescaled h=10 literals. Preserve the grouped neighbor sums for the primal source-informed port. Independent dense tests allow harmless summation roundoff.
spatial_stencil.boundary: Every logical node is updated, including outer padded faces/corners. Only exterior ghost values are fixed zero. Two exterior cells per face suffice for radius 2; native allocated halo width 4 is an allocation detail, not a logical zero boundary.

primal_recurrence.u_next: p+dt*dt*(vp_source*vp_source)*q at the aligned source node; p elsewhere
evaluation_order: Read current and previous rolling slots; compute p over every logical node.
Compute tangent quotient derivative using p before any source injection.
Add source derivative to the next tangent source node.
Add primal source injection using the supplied native vp_source*vp_source, rather than replacing its arithmetic by 1/m_source.
Sample the CURRENT primal and tangent slots at fixed receivers, following the native C order.

tangent_recurrence.u_next_dot: p_dot-dt*dt*q*mu_source/(m_source*m_source) at the aligned source node; p_dot elsewhere
tangent_recurrence.source_dependency: The source q and interpolation coordinates are fixed. The injected 1/m factor is model dependent. Its real-arithmetic derivative is -mu/m^2 even though primal literal fidelity preserves the supplied vp*vp product.
tangent_recurrence.pitfall: Do not replace p by the already injected u_next in p_dot while also adding the explicit source derivative: that double counts a source-related term.
tangent_recurrence.born_equivalence_limit: A post-injection -mu*u_tt form without a separate source derivative is equivalent at the pinned undamped source d_source=0. With nonzero source damping it needs a correction; the explicit pre-injection quotient form above remains valid.

extension_and_gradient_pairing.direction_order: Normalize each fixed direction on the physical grid, then apply E by nearest-edge copying. Do not renormalize after padding.
extension_and_gradient_pairing.duality: <g_padded,E*d_physical>=<E^T*g_padded,d_physical>. E^T sums all padded face and corner contributions onto their generating physical edge/corner nodes.
extension_and_gradient_pairing.naive_crop: Cropping g_padded to physical nodes omits the derivative of constant-edge padding and generally differs from E^T.
